title: Syrian Lamb Kebabs
description: A delicious and spicy dish from Syria, perfect for a quick dinner. Marinated lamb kebabs are grilled to perfection and served with a side of fresh vegetables.
instructions: In a large bowl, whisk together olive oil, garlic, paprika, cumin, salt, and black pepper.
Add the lamb cubes and toss to coat with the marinade.
Cover the bowl with plastic wrap and refrigerate for at least 2 hours or overnight.
Preheat the grill to medium-high heat.
Thread the marinated lamb onto skewers.
Brush the grill with olive oil to prevent sticking.
Grill the kebabs for 8-10 minutes per side, or until cooked through.
Transfer the kebabs to a plate and garnish with chopped parsley.
Serve hot with a side of fresh vegetables, such as tomatoes, cucumbers, and onions.
